description: Each normal daily production run should generate at least 1,000 database-backed component candidates before gap fill, with 2,500 and 5,000 as scale-up targets when validation and load audit remain clean.
Each daily production run should generate 5 to 25 review-ready showcase pipeline templates with pre-LLM, LLM, post-LLM, cost, review, and deployment steps.
Run showcase coverage against generated component candidates and convert partial or missing steps into targeted gap-derived candidate rows when gaps exist.
Merge component and gap partitions into a deduped staged load package, emit bulk-copy SQL, and keep the audit side-effect free until an operator applies it to Postgres.
The run summary should report generated candidates, index records, embedding records, review tickets, showcase templates, coverage status, deduped staged rows, and load SQL path.
